budget_authority: Union of actual native optimize intervals including sequential RMP warm/cold copy canaries, the mandatory adaptive-smoothing bounded fixture solves and overlapping pricing intervals. Build, postsolve validation, disk I/O, tests recorded separately. Conservative cap reserves; no automatic extension. Explicit crash resume only with worst-case in-flight debit against same900s.
dedup: Bit-exact SHA of full raw x/a/c only; Hamming/similarity diagnostic never filters
capture: All distinct negative MIPSOL raw x captured in solver arrival order; final raw X also audited. Outside optimize independently audit every capture; retain first up to4 valid distinct negative trajectories per MESS/call; no ranking/optimum claim and no early stopping.

warm_comparison.trigger: Before RMP after first accepted discovery append

adaptive_smoothing.update: Use alpha_current in current snapshot; compute d_norm from successive TRUE global coupling dual Linf; d_norm>.50 => next=max(.10,.5*current); .10<d_norm<=.50 => unchanged; <=.10 => next=min(.80,1.25*current). All subsequent RMP snapshots update coupling and convexity duals together, including certification diagnostics; certification pricing uses true snapshot only.
adaptive_smoothing.acceptance: full original feasibility and manual smooth RC<=-1e-7 AND manual true RC<=-1e-7, bit-exact dedup only
adaptive_smoothing.stagnation: After3 consecutive discovery rounds with zero accepted columns, immediately schedule certification. If four global BestBd do not provide no-negative authority, record SMOOTHING_STAGNATION=true. No domain restriction/fallback.
adaptive_smoothing.checkpoint: Save true/smooth dual SHAs and vectors, alpha_current/next, both RCs, candidates, accepted columns, wall, cert bracket; explicit resume preserves smoothing state.
adaptive_smoothing.fixture: Full enumeration bounded LP CG with adaptive smoothed discovery plus exact true-dual recovery must match unstabilized/full optimum before first full-domain discovery.

certificate_authority: Only unstabilized OPTIMAL true RMP pi/alpha and four same-dual full-domain terminal global ObjBound. Exact Fraction global residual correction, fixed1e-8 beta safety and outward rounding unchanged.
